subject: Insurance
title: Claims Fraud Detection by AI
description: A quick, practical guide to Claims Fraud Detection by AI.

hook.text: AI detects insurance fraud 17 times faster than human investigators.

buildup.text: Insurance fraud costs $80 billion annually in the US alone. Traditionally, only 1-3% of fraudulent claims were caught.

discovery.text: AI compares each claim against historical fraud patterns: duplicate photos, staged accident signatures.

twist.text: Fraudsters now use AI too. They generate realistic fake damage photos and medical records to beat the detection systems.

climax.text: Insurance fraud is now an AI arms race. Each side's technology improves in response to the other's innovations.

punchline.text: $80 billion in fraud. AI fights AI in an escalating detection war.
